{{Quote|Well done. Hold them in the security tower. And keep it quiet.|Lando Calrissian, upon Lobot's successful execution of Code Force Seven|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Code Force Seven''' was a command that [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] issued to [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Occupation of Bespin|seizure]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Calrissian utilized a [[Wrist link/Legends|wrist link]] to remotely send the command to Lobot, who mobilized the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] in apprehending several Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who had taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. Calrissian and the newly freed Rebels then escaped Cloud City.
